title: Prompt source placeholder literals must change together with the server allowlist
answers: change the dummy-source or prompt-template placeholder value
prompt registration returns 400 after changing the source string
where is the allowed prompt source defined
keep UI and server prompt source placeholder in sync
body:
Mechanism: the server allowlist mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS is built from _CLIENT_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ("dummy-source") and _STORE_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ("prompt-template"). The Python senders import these names: MlflowClient.register_prompt in mlflow/tracking/client.py and AbstractStore.create_prompt_version in mlflow/store/model_registry/abstract_store.py.
What breaks: editing a sender literal without the constant makes prompt registration return HTTP 400 with no compile-time signal.
The UI cannot import Python constants. mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/prompts/api.ts:RegisteredPromptsApi keeps a hardcoded 'dummy-source' with a pointer comment, so it must be updated by hand alongside the allowlist.
applies: Any change to the source value used when creating prompt versions from Python, the UI, or the server allowlist.
says: Creating a prompt version from the prompt engineering page fails with a bad request error.
Registering a new prompt through the client library gets rejected with an invalid source error.
Keep web interface prompt creation and server validation rules synchronized when modifying source placeholders.
Submitting the prompt registration modal returns an unexpected server error about allowed sources.
Ensure client prompt creation uses the same accepted dummy source values as the backend.
search: The server allowlist mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS combines _CLIENT_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ('dummy-source') and _STORE_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER ('prompt-template'). Python senders MlflowClient.register_prompt and AbstractStore.create_prompt_version import these constants, but mismatched sender literals trigger HTTP 400 errors during prompt registration. Because the web UI cannot import Python constants, RegisteredPromptsApi in mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/pages/prompts/api.ts maintains a hardcoded 'dummy-source' that must be manually updated alongside the allowlist.
